_comment: Secureddy detonation chamber seccomp profile. Starts from the set of syscalls Docker's default profile refuses (kernel modules, mounts, raw tracing, clock/host changes, kexec, keyrings, BPF, perf) and keeps refusing them, but allows the namespace calls (clone/clone3 with CLONE_NEW*, unshare, setns) that Chromium's own layer-1 sandbox needs so the renderer sandbox stays on inside the container. Everything not listed is allowed, as in Docker's default profile. Review together with --cap-drop ALL and no-new-privileges in backends/docker.py.

syscalls.comment: Denied by Docker's default profile for unprivileged containers; a page that owns the browser must not get to touch the kernel, mounts, modules or other processes.
